name: 到期管家
description: Due dates and Apple Reminders with public GitHub icon subscriptions, custom JSON sources, local brand search, Fluent Emoji Flat, optional Icons8, per-item artwork and backups.

localizedDescriptions.en: 3.2 adds App, Emby and selfh.st GitHub icon subscriptions plus custom public JSON sources. Catalogues update online, search stays local and images load on demand, without API keys. App names prefer GitHub; generic items retain Fluent Emoji Flat. Icons8 remains an optional provider requiring your own Keychain-stored API key. Manage, enable or remove sources without clearing item artwork. Selected public image links and subscription settings travel with backups. Adaptive sizing, original proportions, light/dark backgrounds and safe system-symbol fallbacks remain; existing items, artwork, recurrence and notifications are unchanged.
localizedDescriptions.zh: 3.2 新增 App、Emby、selfh.st 三个 GitHub 图库订阅及自定义公开 JSON 源：在线更新清单、本机搜索、图片按需加载，无需 API Key。应用名称优先推荐 GitHub 图标；通用事项保留 Fluent，Icons8 作为需自备密钥的可选补充。支持添加、启停和移除订阅，不清除已选事项图标；公开图片链接和订阅设置随备份保存。继续自适配尺寸、原始比例、留白和深浅色背景，失败回退系统符号。旧图案、事项、周期、通知及更新链接不变。

localizedDescriptions.zh-Hant: 3.2 新增 App、Emby、selfh.st 三個 GitHub 圖庫訂閱及自訂公開 JSON 來源：線上更新清單、本機搜尋、圖片按需載入，無需 API Key。應用名稱優先推薦 GitHub 圖示；通用事項保留 Fluent，Icons8 作為需自備金鑰的選用補充。支援新增、啟停和移除訂閱，不清除已選事項圖示；公開圖片連結和訂閱設定隨備份保存。繼續自適配尺寸、原始比例、留白及深淺色背景，失敗退回系統符號。舊圖案、事項、週期、通知及更新連結不變。
